title: Binance Adds CVC/USDT & WBETH/ETH Trading Pairs
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance will open trading for the CVC/USDT and WBETH/ETH trading pairs at  2023-05-12 08:00 (UTC) . Binance Spot Grid will be enabled for the CVC/USDT and WBETH/ETH trading pairs within 48 hours of the trading start time. Start Grid Trading on Binance Spot Now! Notes:  WBETH is a new liquid staking asset representing 1 ETH and the staking rewards accrued on Binance  ETH Staking .  Users  can use WBETH to participate in DeFi projects outside Binance and still receive ETH Staking rewards. For more information, please visit  here . Where any discrepancy arises between the translated versions and the original English version, the English version shall prevail. Thanks for your support!
